notes.title: Ver1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello! This is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.
Today, we’ve released Ver. 1.1.0.
Please see below for the details of the update.


 **New Mode: Online Challenge Mode** Compete with Seekers from around the world in this score and time-based mode!

This mode is only available when playing on the "EXPERT" difficulty. If you clear a dungeon while entered in this mode, the following information will be recorded on the leaderboard:

Clear Score / Clear Time
Character Used
Username
Date & Time of Registration

Challenge it again and again, and test your skills against players worldwide!
Note: Online Challenge Mode is available in the Steam version.

New Feature: Time Display

You can now see the elapsed time during exploration.
This can be toggled ON/OFF from the options menu.
However, during Online Challenge Mode, the timer will be forcibly turned ON.

notes.title: Release Date Set for Collaboration DLC with “Game Center Mikado” on December 5!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.

The release date for our collaboration DLC with Takadanobaba Game Center Mikado, previously mentioned during a live broadcast, has been confirmed! The DLC will be available on Thursday, December 5.

The DLC allows players to transform the appearance of characters in HEAVEN SEEKER into two special forms: “Rock Form,” representing Mikado's manager Minoru Ikeda (also known as Ikeda Minoru Rock), and “Mikado Form,” featuring Mikado’s Vtuber, Mikado-chan.

Using the form skill will change the character’s appearance and equip them with unique shot types. Additionally, a dedicated starting artifact with passive effects will be included.

notes.title: Ver1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.
Today, we released Ver1.0.2.
Please see below for the details of the fixes and adjustments.


・Fixed issues where some achievements could not be obtained:
　- "Unlock All Skills": If the conditions are already met, the achievement will be unlocked upon entering the entrance.
　- "Retain Coins": The achievement will be unlocked by meeting the specified conditions.

・Fixed the following issues with the Grimoire "Thunder":
　- The default trajectory of Thunder was not normal.
　- It was always treated as the minimum value regardless of the accuracy status.
　- When the side book "Burst Bullet" is applied, a shadow of Thunder may occur.

・Fixed the following issues with the side book "Chain Spell":
　- If already hopped with the effect of the side book "Hopper Spell" before chaining, it could not hop again after chaining.

・Fixed the issue where the effect of the artifact "Dodge Manual III" was not working correctly.

・Fixed the following issues with the artifacts "Golden Magic Clock" and "Silver Magic Clock":
　- Not registered in the encyclopedia even when obtained.
　- Disappearing from the inventory when moving areas after acquisition.

・Fixed the issue where the number of bombs obtained by artifact effects exceeded the limit:
　- The maximum number is now 10, just like normal bomb acquisition, and will not exceed this limit.

・Fixed the issue where the beam shot by enemies had a larger hitbox than it appeared.
・Fixed the issue where combos did not increase when defeating the enemy "Devil in the box".
・Fixed the issue where rewards could appear during the defeat sequence of the boss in Area 4.

・Fixed the following UI issues:
　- Able to enter the dungeon while displaying the difficulty UI by interacting again during the dungeon entry sequence.
　- Tooltips in the inventory (item information) could go off-screen.
　- "Mana Consumption Correction" displayed twice in the Grimoire calibration effects section when a side book is applied.
　- Dice possession display misaligns when obtaining dice continuously in a short period.

・Fixed the issue where setting "Slow + Shot" in key configuration made the operation non-functional.
・Fixed the issue where Japanese appeared in the English version during the judgment room.


・Adjusted to reduce the occurrence of forced termination.
・Relaxed the activation conditions for dodging, making inputs easier to accept.

・Adjusted some game balance:
　- Mana consumption correction status has been adjusted.

・Adjusted the text of some side books.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello. This is the HEAVEN SEEKER development team.
Thank you for reporting the bugs.
We have released an update that includes the following fixes and adjustments.

＜Fixes＞
・Fixed an issue where certain achievements could not be obtained correctly.
　-Some achievements requiring no bombs or no damage under specific conditions could not be obtained.
　-Achievements requiring the acquisition of all items and other elements could not be unlocked properly.
　※For achievements requiring the acquisition of all items, if you have already met the conditions, the check for obtaining them will be executed at the following times:
　　When you start an exploration / When you acquire any item in the dungeon.
・Corrected the behavior of the Grimoire "Thunder."
　-The re-shooting position of shots due to the effect of the side book "Chain Spell" was incorrect.
・Fixed an issue where the Grimoire calibration effect of the side book "Spell Lightening" was not displayed correctly.
・Fixed the following issues related to the delay field generated by some enemies:
　-The effect moved along with the enemy's movement, causing a discrepancy with the actual effective range.
・Corrected an issue where images of some side books in the compendium were reversed.
・Fixed the following issues in Sky Castle History:
　-When displaying result details, "High Score" and "New Record" appeared regardless of the actual record.
　-The sorting results for ascending and descending order in "Recent Records" were reversed.
　-In the "Clear Time" category of the history, results that did not meet the conditions were displayed.
・Fixed the following issues in the options menu:
　-After setting the control method from presets, reopening the options menu reset it to default.
　-The "Reset to Default" function in the free key configuration settings did not work correctly.

＜Adjustments＞
・Adjusted the terrain of the entrance.
・Adjusted the terrain of some dungeons to address areas where attacks might not reach.
・Adjusted the default master volume to 50%.
・Made some adjustments to the display of credits and end rolls.

We are currently reviewing and addressing other reported issues.
Thank you for your continued support of HEAVEN SEEKER.

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Full Version
notes.notes:
We would like to introduce the controls for the full version and information on current issues.


This is a topic about the controls. It is intended for those who have played the Prologue version.
To make it easier and more enjoyable to play, we have changed the default controls. We have adjusted some key configurations for both keyboard & mouse and gamepad operations. We hope that even those who played the Prologue version will go through the tutorial.

Additionally, we have provided a feature to freely change key configurations, so please make use of it.


Next, we would like to inform you about known issues. We are working to fix the following bugs as soon as possible:
・In the boss battle of Area 4, if defeated at a specific timing, the attacks do not stop.
・In certain boss battles, rewards for no-damage victories are not granted.
・Some achievements that require no damage may not be obtained correctly.
・When setting controls using presets, reopening the control options screen resets them to default.
・The "Reset to Default" option does not function correctly in the free key configuration settings.
・The clear time order and recent record display in the Sky Castle History are not displayed correctly.

Thank you for your support of 'Heaven Seeker'.

Heaven Seeker Development Team
